Installation Guide (Java 1.20 / 1.20.1)

Step 1: Download files

- CorruptedRP.zip (Resource Pack)
- CorruptedDP.zip (Datapack)

Step 2: Install Resource Pack

1. Open .minecraft/resourcepacks/
2. Put CorruptedRP.zip inside
3. Open the game
4. Go to Options → Resource Packs
5. Enable CorruptedRP

Step 3: Install Datapack

1. Open .minecraft/saves/YourWorld/
2. Open or create a folder named "datapacks"
3. Put CorruptedDP.zip inside

Step 4: Activate

1. Enter your world
2. Run command: /reload

What this pack does

- Fake players (Herobrine, Null, Entity_303)
  - Join and leave randomly
  - Appear in TAB list
  - Send messages
- Footsteps behind you
- Glitched item names
- Screen distortion effects
- Random visual effects

Warning
This pack is made for prank or horror use
May feel unsettling and affect gameplay

Tips

- Best played alone
- Use headphones for full experience
- Use with the resource pack for maximum effect
